The FDA set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) date of June 15, 2027.
The Company is in discussions with the FDA and is hopeful for an approval before the PDUFA date.

Idvynso is also under review in the U.S. to expand the approved indication in certain virologically suppressed adults with HIV-1 infection to include certain adults who have not previously received antiretroviral treatment; the FDA set a PDUFA date of April 22, 2027.
In the U.S., the FDA set a PDUFA date of March 22, 2027.
